map.五子棋人机对战 使用指南: Gomoku Match Against the Computer User Guide
map.规则同五子棋；AI 启发式评估棋盘：优先成五 > 堵对方活四 > 自己做活四/活: Rules are the same as gomoku; the AI evaluates the board heuristically: making five > blocking the opponent's open four > making your own open four/open three > blocking a rush four. Higher difficulty searches deeper and misses fewer defences. ...
map.人机对战：与内置 AI 轮流落子，先连五子胜，适合单人练棋。: Match against the computer: take turns placing stones with the built-in AI, first to five in a row wins, suitable for solo practice.
map.难度调节：AI 按搜索深度/棋型权重评估，可调强中弱。: Difficulty adjustment: the AI evaluates by search depth and shape weights, with strong, medium and weak settings.
map.算法演示：观察 AI 如何优先堵活四、抢活三，理解启发式博弈。: Algorithm demonstration: watch how the AI prioritizes blocking an open four and making an open three, to understand heuristic play.
map.通常玩家执黑先手；若想挑战，可选 AI 先手增加难度: Usually the player takes black and moves first; for a challenge you can let the AI move first to raise the difficulty
map.启发式 + 浅层搜索，约业余中级；高水平玩家可用双活三/冲四逼其失误。: Heuristics plus shallow search, roughly intermediate amateur level; strong players can force mistakes with double open threes or rush fours.
